claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_feat category choice / any_qualifying_feat
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The existing class_feature passive family fits, but the current grant_feat payload only allows one fixed feat category. This rule grants one feat chosen from either Epic Boon feats or another qualifying feat, which cannot be represented honestly as a single fixed category.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You gain an Epic Boon feat (see "Feats") or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.
